indexes._comment: invoices-1: Advertiser invoice list, newest-first. Primary query for advertiser portal.
invoices-2: Advertiser invoice list filtered by status (e.g. UNPAID, PAID). Newest-first.
invoices-3: Admin view — all invoices by status, newest-first.
loops-1: Loop management — filter by status + date (e.g. pending loops for a given date).
loops-2: approve-all query (S13-2 / S16-2) — location_id + status + date.
